title: Launch WebOps Factory
audience: Small web teams and agency owners who need a reviewable way to repair static websites.
objective: Create a benefits-first launch campaign for WebOps Factory: explain how the visible factory floor takes a static website through bounded checks, focused repairs and review. Include accurate instructions for trying the public repository.
voice: Plain, confident English. Concrete benefits, no hype, no invented personal biography.
constraints: Attribute repository-described behavior. Treat recorded timings as observations, never promises.
State that supported static-site checks are bounded; human review and deployment remain separate.
Keep setup commands complete and grounded in the captured README.
